claim_boundary: The 13 rows are response-prioritized source entity-pair hypotheses, not 13 metabolites. Library-policy evidence permits two source-pair identity merges. Analytical-family components are phenotype-blind redundancy hypotheses and do not themselves confirm a common neutral molecule.
diagnostic_score_boundary: diagnostic_raw_sqrt_cosine_0p02 is recomputed from exact MGF peaks with a greedy 0.02-Da matcher. It is response-blind but is not a frozen Atlas model score and must not replace the canonical cross-study WSE.
scientific_question: How many of the 13 PRISM-prioritized source entity-pair hypotheses have policy-qualified identity evidence, and how many remain after a phenotype-blind coelution/adduct-family redundancy audit?
unknown_increment_boundary: Family collapse changes both numerator and denominator. Unknown enrichment must not be recomputed by collapsing only the 13 prioritized pairs; the full set of 101 retained testable pairs requires the same phenotype-blind family procedure.
